content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect an operator device to [product_name] [article_no], or does the newer hardware only support communication with the updated operator panels?
The earlier operator device (without E) works only with controller versions up to [article_no]. The newer operator panel is required for controllers from [article_no] onward.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking information about compatibility between different operator panels and controller versions. There is some confusion about whether older operator devices can be used with newer hardware, which brings up concerns about needing to purchase updated equipment.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are hoping for compatibility across different operator devices and controller hardware versions.
